set.prevailing_wage_basis: 24 CFR 983.153(c) (HUD PBV development requirements, labor standards): for development activity (new construction or rehabilitation) involving nine or more PBV contract units, the owner and its contractors must pay Davis-Bacon wages and the PHA monitors compliance; existing-housing PBV contracts with no development activity do not trigger it. https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/24/983.153 The December 8, 2025 HACCC PBV invitation also states Federal Labor Standards may be applicable.
set.audit_note: Tier 4 spot check November 9, 2026: HACCC closed solicitations page and the December 8, 2025 PBV invitation confirm up to 15 units, existing properties with no more than $3,000 per unit of rehab, CoC PBRA conversion purpose, jurisdiction excluding Pittsburg, due January 8, 2026. No newer PBV solicitation posted.

reason: Material: prevailing_wage_trigger false is contradicted by 24 CFR 983.153(c) Davis-Bacon at 9 or more PBV contract units for new construction or rehab, which the record lists as eligible; RFP terms match.
